## Context

A golden fixture brief that pins the artifact contract: a deterministic
widget that does one observable thing, used only by contract-test.sh.

Source: https://example.com/golden-fixture

## Requirements

- [ ] R1: WHEN a widget input arrives, THE SYSTEM SHALL append it to the widget log exactly once
- [ ] R2: WHEN the widget log is read, THE SYSTEM SHALL return entries in arrival order

## Out of scope

- Review and verification of this spec (Phase 3 spec-checker loop).
- Implementation of the requirements above (executor consumption of the queue).

## Acceptance (Gherkin)

- Scenario: R1 — a widget input arrives
  Given the integration surface listed in the brief is in place
  When a widget input arrives
  Then the system SHALL append it to the widget log exactly once
- Scenario: R2 — the widget log is read
  Given the integration surface listed in the brief is in place
  When the widget log is read
  Then the system SHALL return entries in arrival order
